事務機、本站、你的工作區在同一個內網裡；檔案從事務機直接進工作區，不經過任何雲端: The MFP, this site and your workspace are on the same internal network; files go from the MFP straight into your workspace without passing through any cloud service.
eSCL 掃描、機內信箱、文件伺服器、檔案分享: eSCL scanning, mailboxes, Document Server, file shares
在同一個內網，替你連線、取件、轉成 PDF: On the same network; connects, retrieves and converts to PDF for you
每個帳號各自一份，保留時間由管理員設定: One per account; the retention period is set by the administrator
設定共用事務機，按「成員」決定誰可以用（使用者、群組、組織單位）: Set up shared MFPs and choose who can use them under Members (users, groups, organisational units)
連線測試的逐步診斷與診斷報告，追查連不上的原因: Use the step-by-step diagnostics and the diagnostic report to find out why a device cannot be reached
在「事務機掃描取件」頁看到自己新增的與管理員共用的事務機: See the MFPs you added and those shared by an administrator on the MFP Scan & Fetch page
按「掃描」從本站叫事務機掃描，或按「取件」取回存在事務機裡的文件: Press Scan to start a scan from this site, or Retrieve to fetch documents stored on the MFP
取好的檔案在工作區，可以開啟、下載或接著用其他工具: Retrieved files are in your workspace, ready to open, download or use with other tools
在「設定 → 共用事務機」建立一次，指定成員之後，成員在自己的「事務機掃描取件」: Create it once under Settings → Shared MFPs and choose the members; they then see and use it on their own MFP Scan & Fetch page.
輸入事務機的 IP 或主機名稱，按「連線測試」。只讀首頁與掃描介面的能力表，不送: Enter the MFP's IP address or host name and press Connection test. It only reads the home page and the scan interface's capabilities, and sends no credentials.
看一下廠牌、型號與相容性，按「儲存為共用事務機」。: Check the brand, model and compatibility, then press Save as a shared MFP.
按「成員」勾選使用者或群組。群組旁邊的「本站 N 人」是已經算進這個群組的帳號數: Press Members and tick users or groups. "N on this site" next to a group is the number of accounts already counted in it.
管理員也要列在成員裡，這台才會出現在自己的「事務機掃描取件」頁（標「你是成員」）: Administrators must also be members for the device to appear on their own MFP Scan & Fetch page (marked "You are a member").
共用事務機的成員設定：使用者寫成帳號@來源，群組旁標出本站人數: Members of a shared MFP: users shown as account@source, groups with the number of accounts on this site
成員面板：使用者寫成 <code>帳號@來源</code>，同名的標「同名帳號」: The members panel: users are shown as account@source, accounts with the same name are marked, and each group shows how many accounts it has on this site.
想讓大家只用共用的事務機：在同一頁的「使用設定」關掉「允許使用者自行新增事務機」: To have everyone use only shared MFPs, turn off "Allow users to add their own MFPs" under Usage settings on the same page. Administrators are not affected.
清單上有你自己新增的（只有你的帳號看得到）與管理員共用的；相容性、可以做的事都標: The list has the MFPs you added (visible only to your account) and those shared by an administrator; compatibility and the available actions are on the same row.
我的事務機清單：來源、位址、型號、相容性與掃描、取件按鈕: The My MFPs list: source, address, model, compatibility and scan / retrieve buttons
「來源」分「自己新增」與「管理員共用」；相容性「已支援」是已在實機驗證的型號。: Source is either "Added by you" or "Shared by admin"; "Supported" means the model has been verified on a real device.
在「新增事務機」輸入位址，按「連線測試」。: Enter the address under Add an MFP and press Connection test.
廠牌、型號、相容性、能不能從本站掃描，以及每一步的診斷。: Brand, model, compatibility, whether it can scan from this site, and the diagnostics for every step.
取個好認的名稱後按「儲存這台事務機」；換一台電腦用同一個帳號登入照樣在。: Give it a recognisable name and press Save this MFP; it is still there when you sign in with the same account on another computer.
連線測試結果：連線、TLS、廠牌、型號、相容性與逐步診斷: Connection test result: connection, TLS, brand, model, compatibility and step-by-step diagnostics
連線測試的結果卡片與逐步診斷；需要時可以下載診斷報告。: The connection test result cards and step-by-step diagnostics; a diagnostic report can be downloaded when needed.
支援 eSCL 的事務機，清單上有「掃描」：在本站選好設定，事務機就開始掃，掃好: MFPs that support eSCL have a Scan button: choose the settings here, the MFP starts scanning and the result goes straight into your workspace.
把文件放在平台玻璃上，或放進自動送紙器。: Put the document on the flatbed glass or in the document feeder.
按「掃描」，選來源、色彩、解析度、紙張、存成 PDF 或 JPEG，可以先取檔名: Press Scan and choose the source, colour, resolution, paper and PDF or JPEG; you can name the file first.
按「開始掃描」。有人在用時會自動排隊，畫面顯示前面還有幾件。: Press Start scan. If someone else is using the device you queue automatically, and the page shows how many are ahead of you.
完成後可以開啟、下載，或到工作區接著處理。: When it finishes you can open it, download it or continue in your workspace.
掃描面板：來源、色彩、解析度、紙張、存成與檔名: The scan panel: source, colour, resolution, paper, format and file name
掃描設定：只列出這台事務機支援的選項。: Scan settings: only the options this MFP supports are listed.
掃描完成：頁數、協定與開啟、下載、前往工作區: Scan finished: pages, protocol, and open / download / go to workspace
完成：存進工作區，可以開啟或下載。: Done: saved to your workspace, ready to open or download.
取件：把存在事務機裡的文件取回來: Retrieve documents stored on the MFP
先在事務機的面板上把文件存進信箱、文件伺服器或資料盒，再到本站按「取件」（FUJ: First store the document in a mailbox, the Document Server or a box on the MFP's panel, then press Retrieve here (Mailbox retrieval on FUJIFILM).
依廠牌在面板上選存到信箱、文件伺服器或資料盒（見下方「各廠牌」）。: On the panel, store it in a mailbox, the Document Server or a box depending on the brand (see Brands below).
依面板顯示填信箱編號、帳號或 User Code。只送一次，錯了就停下來。: Enter the mailbox number, account or User Code as the panel requires. They are sent once; if they are wrong it stops there.
按「列出檔案」；有資料夾的在「位置」切換，資料夾有密碼時輸入後按「開啟資料夾」。: Press List files; switch folders under Position, and for a password-protected folder enter the password and press Open folder.
勾選要的文件，選存成 PDF（建議）後按「取件」，檔案存進工作區。: Tick the documents you want, choose PDF (recommended) and press Retrieve; the files are saved to your workspace.
FUJIFILM 信箱取件：信箱編號、文件清單、取件與取件並刪除: FUJIFILM mailbox retrieval: mailbox number, document list, retrieve and fetch-and-delete
FUJIFILM 信箱取件：可以選「取件並刪除」，確認存好之後才刪事務機上的原件: FUJIFILM mailbox retrieval: Fetch and delete removes the originals from the MFP only after confirming they were saved.
RICOH 文件伺服器取件：登入方式、位置選資料夾、資料夾密碼與文件清單: RICOH Document Server retrieval: sign-in method, folder selection, folder password and document list
RICOH 文件伺服器：在「位置」切換共用資料夾與設備資料夾，有密碼的標出來。: RICOH Document Server: switch between the shared folder and device folders under Position; password-protected ones are marked.
技術細節：協定紀錄與複製協定紀錄按鈕: Technical details: the protocol log and the Copy protocol log button
「已支援」是在實機上驗證過取件的型號（FUJIFILM 同系列以 Apeos C: "Supported" means retrieval has been verified on a real device (the FUJIFILM series models are covered by the Apeos C5571 test); "Experimental" was built from the vendor manuals or analysis of the vendor tools and has not been verified on a real device yet.
在事務機上怎麼存: How to store it on the MFP
在面板選「掃描至信箱」，存進指定的信箱: Choose Scan to Mailbox on the panel and store it in the mailbox
信箱編號；信箱有設密碼才填密碼: Mailbox number; the password only if the mailbox has one

在面板選「掃描至資料夾」並「儲存檔案」，存進文件伺服器的共用資料夾或設備資料夾: Choose Scan to Folder with Store File on the panel, into the Document Server's shared folder or a device folder

存進自訂資料盒（機型要有硬碟或 SSD）: Store it in a custom box (the model needs a hard disk or SSD)
事務機帳號密碼；文件匣有設密碼才填: The MFP account and password; the box password only if set
<span class=\"mg-pill mg-pill-exp\">實驗功能: Experimental. On models without custom boxes, the polling box can only be listed for now

存進事務機的 NAS 資料夾: Store it in the MFP's NAS folder
不用先存，直接在本站按「掃描」: Nothing to store first; press Scan on this site
<span class=\"mg-pill mg-pill-scan\">可以掃: Can scan (models that support eSCL; only the HP LaserJet MFP M141w has been tested on a real device)
事務機上常有合約、薪資單這類文件，所以每一步都照最保守的方式做。: MFPs often hold contracts and payslips, so every step takes the most conservative approach.
事務機的位址只能是內部網路；連線測試只讀首頁與掃描介面的能力表，不送任何帳號密碼: MFP addresses must be on the internal network; the connection test only reads the home page and the scan interface's capabilities and sends no credentials.
取件時填的密碼只用在這一次，下次要再輸入；記住的是設備帳號名稱、信箱編號、信任的: The password you enter when fetching is used only that once and must be entered again next time; what is remembered is settings such as the device account name, the box number and the trusted certificate, stored with your account.
帳號、信箱或資料夾密碼錯了就停下來，不換方式重試，避免連續輸錯讓事務機鎖住帳號。: A wrong account, mailbox or folder password stops there with no retry using another method, so repeated failures do not get the account locked on the MFP.
取件只列出、下載，不刪除、不改名；只有 FUJIFILM 可以選「取件並刪除」，: Retrieval only lists and downloads, never deletes or renames; only FUJIFILM offers Fetch and delete, which deletes only after the files are confirmed saved.
同一台事務機一次只服務一個人，其他人自動排隊：每台最多 10 件（含正在執行的）: Each MFP serves one person at a time and others queue automatically: up to 10 jobs per device (including the one running), up to 2 per person per device, and a job is dropped after waiting more than 30 minutes.
用 HTTP 或 SMB 這類沒有加密的方式傳送前，要先同意一次；共用事務機由管: Before sending anything over an unencrypted connection such as HTTP or SMB, you are asked to agree once; for shared MFPs the administrator decides.
沒有啟用登入時，這個工具只接受這台電腦本機的連線，從別台電腦連進來會被拒絕。: Without sign-in enabled, this tool only accepts connections from this computer; requests from other computers are rejected.
連線測試的診斷報告與協定紀錄不含帳號、密碼與文件內容，可以直接附給系統管理員。: The connection test's diagnostic report and the protocol log contain no account names, passwords or document content, so they can be passed straight to your administrator.
誰在什麼時候對哪一台掃描、取件、刪了哪幾份，都寫進稽核記錄（不記密碼與文件內容）: Who scanned or retrieved what on which device, and which originals were deleted, goes into the audit log (no passwords or document contents).
還是遇到問題時，先看這幾個。: If something still goes wrong, start here.
看不到管理員共用的事務機: I cannot see an MFP shared by the administrator
先看頁面上的「目前登入的帳號」：同一個人的 AD、SSO、本機帳號是不同帳號，成: Check "Signed in as" on the page: one person's AD, SSO and local accounts are different accounts, and the member must be the one you actually sign in with. The administrator can also add a group you belong to; "0 on this site" next to a group means it was not attached at sign-in. Switching back to the tab refreshes the list.
連線測試失敗或列不出檔案: The connection test fails or files cannot be listed
看連線測試的逐步診斷，哪一步失敗就從那一步查；也可以下載診斷報告（txt、md、: Follow the connection test's step-by-step diagnostics from the step that failed, or download the diagnostic report (txt, md, json, html, pdf) for the administrator. KYOCERA needs the document service enabled on port 9091 or 9090; if a FUJIFILM port returns 406, choose the other connection method.
RICOH 的資料夾要密碼: A RICOH folder needs a password
在「位置」選那個資料夾，輸入資料夾密碼後按「開啟資料夾」。密碼錯了不會自動重試，: Choose the folder under Position, enter the folder password and press Open folder. A wrong password is not retried automatically; check it and enter it again.
辨識規則更新過，這台之前沒認出型號。按一次「重新測試」就會用新的規則判斷。: The identification rules have changed since this device was tested without being identified. Press Test again to use the new rules.
在你的工作區，可以開啟、下載，或在其他工具裡直接選工作區的檔案。保留時間由管理員: In your workspace: open or download them, or pick them directly in other tools. The retention period is set by the administrator (24 hours by default).
要用程式呼叫：見 <a href=\"api.html#連線測試\">API 使: To call it from your own programs, see the API manual.
PDF / Office 整合式文件處理平台：不上雲，資料留在自己手中。: An integrated PDF / Office document platform: no cloud, your data stays with you.
掃描完的文件要送到自己手上，常見的三種做法各有難處：: There are three common ways to get a scanned document to yourself, and each has its problems:
每台事務機都要設定郵件伺服器與寄件帳號，維護麻煩；大型文件常超過附件或信箱容量上: Every MFP needs its own mail server and sender account, which is tedious to maintain, and large documents often exceed the attachment or mailbox size limit and never arrive.
共用區通常很多人都有權限，合約、人事資料這類機密文件放進去，誰都能開啟或取走。: Many people usually have access to a shared folder, so anyone can open or take a confidential document such as a contract or HR record left there.
用 USB 隨身碟取件: Collect with a USB flash drive
隨身碟容易遺失，也可能帶進惡意程式；不少單位的資安規範已限制使用。: Flash drives are easy to lose and can bring in malware, and many organisations restrict them in their security policies.
<b>事務機掃描取件</b>：在本站直接叫事務機掃描，或取回存在事務機裡的文件，: MFP Scan & Fetch: start a scan on the MFP from this site, or retrieve documents stored on the MFP. Files go only into your own workspace, ready for OCR, merging, compression or translation.
決定要不要開放使用者自行輸入 IP 新增事務機（預設開放；關掉之後大家只用共用的: Decide whether users may add an MFP themselves by entering its IP address (on by default; turn it off and everyone uses the shared ones)
管理員有開放時，也可以自己輸入事務機的 IP 新增，只有自己的帳號看得到: If the administrator allows it, add an MFP yourself by entering its IP address; only your account sees it
以下說明以每位使用者都有自己的帳號（已啟用登入）為前提。: This guide assumes that every user has their own account (sign-in enabled).
單機版只適合一個人在自己的電腦上使用，而且服務只開在本機（<code>127.0: The standalone edition is only for one person on their own computer, with the service listening on this machine only (127.0.0.1); without sign-in enabled, this tool rejects requests from other computers. Steps and notes: standalone guide.
刪除事務機會影響到誰: Who is affected when an MFP is deleted
<b>自己新增的</b>（來源「自己新增」）只有你看得到，刪了不影響任何人，管理: One you added yourself (source: Added by you) is visible only to you, so deleting it affects nobody, and a shared MFP for the same device keeps working. A shared MFP (source: Shared by admin) can only be deleted by an administrator under Settings → Shared MFPs; once deleted, no member can see or use it. In both cases the scan and retrieval history for that MFP is kept and marked as Removed.
每個人有自己的事務機清單與工作區；管理員可以設定共用事務機並指定成員。: Each person has their own MFP list and workspace; administrators can set up shared MFPs and choose members.
單機版（一個人在自己的電腦上）: Single-user (one person on their own computer)
未啟用登入，服務只開在本機（<code>127.0.0.1</code>），只有: Sign-in is not enabled, the service listens only on this computer (127.0.0.1), and only you use it.
啟用登入後，每個人的事務機清單與工作區各自分開。這套系統架成伺服器給多人使用、卻: With sign-in enabled, each person has a separate MFP list and workspace. If this system runs as a server for several people without sign-in, everyone shares one workspace and anyone who can reach the site can see the scanned and retrieved files, so documents containing confidential or personal data are effectively exposed.
出問題時展開「技術細節」，按「複製協定紀錄」附給系統管理員；紀錄不含帳號、密碼與: When something goes wrong, open Technical details, press Copy protocol log and attach it for your system administrator; the log contains no accounts, passwords or document contents.
展開「技術細節」，按「複製協定紀錄」，把內容附給你們的系統管理員；管理員要再往上: Open Technical details, press Copy protocol log and give the contents to your system administrator; if the administrator needs to report it further, attach it to an issue on GitHub. The protocol log contains no accounts, passwords or document contents. Report at: GitHub Issues.
